title: Spanish Apricot Chicken Fideua
description: A twist on traditional Spanish fideua, this recipe pairs the nutty flavor of fideua with the sweetness of apricot and the spice of zesty chicken.

ingredients.name: Zesty Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: olive oil infused with garlic and chili peppers

ingredients.name: Spanish Smoked Paprika
ingredients.notes: smoked paprika adds a smoky depth

instructions: Cook the fideua according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Heat the zesty olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the diced apricot to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked fideua to the skillet and toss to combine with the chicken and apricot mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Spanish Apricot Chicken Fideua!
